uncited: The core mechanism involves constructing a bounding volume hierarchy (BVH) or similar tree structure in parallel on the GPU.
The construction process typically adapts algorithms originally designed for triangle geometry to sparse volumetric data.

detail: supported

Parallel tree-construction algorithms enable the run-time re-construction of acceleration data structures for empty-space skipping, primarily to accommodate dynamic changes in the transfer function [S1, unofficial].

The evidence directly supports every part of the claim.

The claim accurately reflects this by stating that the parallel nature allows for rapid regeneration (run-time re-construction) necessary when the transfer function changes, which affects the definition of empty/occupied regions (empty-space skipping).
